post.caption:
The asteroid is the famous one, but the End-Permian was far worse: around 90% of marine species gone, driven by two million years of Siberian volcanism, CO₂ and ocean acidification. Recovery took millions of years each time, and each reset changed who inherited the planet. Mammals only got their chance because of the last one.
